status: PREPARED ONLY: dataset and core integration gates must pass before an explicitly authorized fresh launch

ensemble_safety_r4.crossfit: leave one source group out within INNER only
ensemble_safety_r4.fallback: three_mask_fixed_mean regardless of CNN ranking; report CNN separately
ensemble_safety_r4.outer_gate_role: post-evaluation pass/fail report only; no OOF refit, reselection or prediction replacement

diagnostic_baselines.train_mean: CPU constant equal to each fold TRAIN share mean; no heldout fitting
diagnostic_baselines.three_mask_fixed_mean: equal mean of cnn/fdy/itransformer; fixed a priori
diagnostic_baselines.cnn: standalone CNN reported even when better than the selected fallback

loss: share MSE + 0.25 energy-weighted cell MSE + 0.05 presence BCE; no CNN prior-logit residual penalty

cnn_policy.background_prior_role: two input channels only; no additive prior logits in output

experiment_policy: One frozen four-candidate, five-fold run. No TFM, TabM, base LightGBM, automatic ablations, parameter changes, challenge inference or official submission.
dataset_policy: Require the completed R4 passage source package and matching fold/source/SHA gates. Exact counts come from the generated manifests; source independence is not inferred from synthetic row count.
final_assessment: OOF is development evidence after comparison. Calibration, sealed data and challenge Test remain unopened by training and policy selection.
